# crosswork_network_devices (Resource)

This resource can manage a network device in inventory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_network_devices" "example" {
  name               = "cwtest-gen-device"
  host_name          = "cwtest-device"
  credential_profile = "cwtest-device-profile"
  admin_state        = "ROBOT_ADMIN_STATE_UP"
  reachability_check = "REACH_CHECK_ENABLE"
  serial_number      = "FOC1234ABCD"
  mac_address        = "00:1b:44:11:3a:b7"
  encryption         = "aes128-ctr"
  device_type        = "NODE_TYPE_ROUTER"
  software_type      = "IOS XR"
  syslog_format      = "RFC_5424"
  capabilities       = ["YANG_CLI"]
  cli_cache_enabled  = false
  provider_profile   = "nso"
  connectivity = [
    {
      protocol      = "ROBOT_MSVC_TRANS_SSH"
      ip_address    = "192.0.2.231"
      prefix_length = 24
      port          = 22
      timeout       = 60
    }
  ]
  isis_system_id                  = "0000.0000.0001"
  ospf_router_id                  = "192.0.2.1"
  te_router_id                    = "192.0.2.2"
  ipv6_router_id                  = "2001:db8::1"
  telemetry_vrf                   = "default"
  telemetry_source_interface      = "Loopback0"
  telemetry_opt_out_of_mdt_config = false
  location_building               = "Building 1"
  location_street                 = "Main Street"
  location_city                   = "Amsterdam"
  location_state                  = "North Holland"
  location_country                = "Netherlands"
  location_region                 = "EMEA"
  location_zip                    = "1011"
  location_latitude               = 52.37
  location_longitude              = 4.89
  location_altitude               = 10
  tags = [
    {
      name = "cwtest-tag"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `connectivity` (Attributes List) Connectivity rows, one per protocol. A change to an address, a prefix length or a port needs the device admin down, which is done automatically (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connectivity))
- `credential_profile` (String) Name of the credential profile, which should hold a credential for every protocol the device uses
- `name` (String) Inventory id of the device. A change replaces the device

### Optional

- `admin_state` (String) Admin state of the device. Crosswork keeps a device that is not attached to a data gateway admin down. Attaching a device to a data gateway brings it admin up. The default is `ROBOT_ADMIN_STATE_DOWN`; `ROBOT_ADMIN_STATE_UNMANAGED` cannot be used while a device is attached to a data gateway
  - Choices: `ROBOT_ADMIN_STATE_UP`, `ROBOT_ADMIN_STATE_DOWN`, `ROBOT_ADMIN_STATE_UNMANAGED`
  - Default value: `ROBOT_ADMIN_STATE_DOWN`
- `capabilities` (Set of String) Capabilities of the device, any of `YANG_MDT`, `YANG_CLI`, `SNMP` and `GNMI`; `SNMP` needs an SNMP row. A change needs the device admin down, which is done automatically
- `cli_cache_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Crosswork caches the CLI output of the device
  - Default value: `false`
- `device_type` (String) Device type
  - Choices: `NODE_TYPE_ROUTER`, `NODE_TYPE_SWITCH`, `NODE_TYPE_UNKNOWN`
  - Default value: `NODE_TYPE_ROUTER`
- `encryption` (String) SNMP encryption of the device in the lower case form, for example `aes128-ctr`; leave it unset for none
- `host_name` (String) Host name of the device; needed when the device has no SNMP row. A device with an SNMP row reports its own host name, which replaces the value given here once Crosswork has collected the device; leave it unset to keep the host name the controller holds. A change needs the device admin down, which is done automatically
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `ipv6_router_id` (String) IPv6 router id
- `isis_system_id` (String) ISIS system id
- `location_altitude` (Number) Altitude
- `location_building` (String) Building
- `location_city` (String) City
- `location_country` (String) Country
- `location_latitude` (Number) Latitude; set it together with the longitude
  - Range: `-90`-`90`
- `location_longitude` (Number) Longitude; set it together with the latitude
  - Range: `-180`-`180`
- `location_region` (String) Region
- `location_state` (String) State
- `location_street` (String) Street
- `location_zip` (String) Zip code
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the device
- `ospf_router_id` (String) OSPF router id
- `product_type` (String) Product type. Crosswork overwrites it after it discovers the device, so set it only for a device it cannot reach
- `provider_profile` (String) Name of the NSO provider profile that manages the device
- `reachability_check` (String) Whether Crosswork checks that the device is reachable. A change needs the device admin down, which is done automatically
  - Choices: `REACH_CHECK_ENABLE`, `REACH_CHECK_DISABLE`
  - Default value: `REACH_CHECK_ENABLE`
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number of the device
- `software_type` (String) Software type, for example `IOS XR`; needed when the device has no SNMP row
- `software_version` (String) Software version. Crosswork overwrites it after it discovers the device, so set it only for a device it cannot reach
- `syslog_format` (String) Syslog format of the device
  - Choices: `RFC_5424`, `RFC_3164`, `RFC_UNKNOWN`
  - Default value: `RFC_5424`
- `tags` (Attributes Set) User-defined tags of the device, which must exist as tags. The tags that Crosswork adds itself are never managed (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `te_router_id` (String) TE router id. A change needs the device admin down, which is done automatically
- `telemetry_opt_out_of_mdt_config` (Boolean) Whether to opt out of the MDT configuration
  - Default value: `false`
- `telemetry_source_interface` (String) Source interface of the streaming telemetry
- `telemetry_vrf` (String) VRF of the streaming telemetry source interface

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--connectivity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connectivity`

Required:

- `ip_address` (String) IPv4 address of the device, unique on the Crosswork cluster
- `port` (Number) Port of the protocol, for example 22 for SSH and 161 for SNMP; Crosswork refuses a row without one
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the address
  - Range: `1`-`32`
- `protocol` (String) Protocol to connect to the device
  - Choices: `ROBOT_MSVC_TRANS_SSH`, `ROBOT_MSVC_TRANS_SNMP`, `ROBOT_MSVC_TRANS_NETCONF`, `ROBOT_MSVC_TRANS_HTTP`, `ROBOT_MSVC_TRANS_HTTPS`, `ROBOT_MSVC_TRANS_TELNET`, `ROBOT_MSVC_TRANS_GNMI`, `ROBOT_MSVC_TRANS_GRPC`

Optional:

- `disable_trap_community_check` (Boolean) Whether to skip the trap community check, for the SNMP row
  - Default value: `false`
- `encoding_type` (String) Encoding, required for GNMI and GRPC rows
  - Choices: `JSON`, `BYTES`, `PROTO`, `ASCII`, `JSON_IETF`
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds
- `trap_source_ip` (String) Trap source IPv4 address, for the SNMP row


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Required:

- `name` (String) Tag name

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_network_devices.example "<name>"
```
